items.title: A Fundamental Right
items.summary: With its new law that makes education a fundamental right with effect from April 1, 2010, India joins a small group of countries with such a statutory provision. All children in the 6 to 14 age group can exercise the right under the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009. An estimated one crore children who do not go to school now are expected to benefit.

items.title: Violent clash between KSU, Youth Congress and SFI in Kerala University premises
items.summary: Follow TNM's WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. A series of violent clashes and protests erupted in Thiruvananthapuram University College and later on the streets of the city between the Students' Federation of India (SFI), the student wing of Communist Party of India (Marxist) [CPI(M)] and the Youth Congress and the Kerala Students' Union (KSU), the student wing of Congress, on the evening of Wednesday, September 30. The first clash lasted for nearly three to four hours outside the University men's hostel and University college near Palayam. Following the clash, the city also witnessed protests by the Democratic Youth Federation of India (DYFI). Senior CPI(M) leader and Leader of Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan and former minister V Sivankutty also came to the protest venue. The issue reportedly began when the Youth Congress conducted a protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
